name: Isabelle Dubois
bio:
Isabelle Dubois is a seasoned sporting director with a passion for motorsport ignited during her childhood watching Formula One races with her father. Her career began as a data analyst for a small racing team, where she quickly distinguished herself with her sharp analytical skills and ability to identify critical performance improvements. This led to roles in race strategy and eventually, team management.

At Stewart-Haas Racing, Isabelle is known for her calm and decisive leadership style, particularly under pressure. She believes in fostering a collaborative environment where data-driven insights and innovative thinking are valued. She is dedicated to mentoring young talent and constantly seeks new ways to optimize team performance, both on and off the track. Isabelle is particularly driven by the challenge of leveraging technology to gain a competitive edge.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back into a low ponytail
physical.description: A slender woman with a focused gaze and a practical, no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific brand of Swiss dark chocolate in her office at all times.
